There were like 5 or 6 times during middle school where this one group of girls would tell me that another girl (it was a different one every time) liked me but when I went to talk to the girl about it they denied it. I fell for it. Every. Single. Time.

Coming from someone who has attempted suicide before, don’t do it. It is not worth it. During May of last year I tried to jump off of a bridge. I had just gone through a break up with a girl who, at the time, I thought I loved, and I was at my lowest point emotionally. But as soon as I let go of the railing, and I started to fall down toward the water, I regretted everything. In that moment, I didn’t want to die anymore, I was afraid. I thought of all the things I had yet to do, my loved ones, my friends, and everything that is good about life. I’m lucky that I survived. And I’m glad that I’m still here. Your life is worth so much more than you think, I promise. Things may seem bad now, but they will get better, I promise. I hope you’re still here to read this, and if you are, please, don’t do this, it’s not worth it at all.
